title: Fed rate hike bolsters US Dollar Index above 100.00
summary: The Dollar Index broke above 100.00, back above both of its long-run averages. The quarter-point that took the Fed to 3.75-4.00% was fully priced and worth nothing on its own.

title: Dow Jones Industrial Average slides behind a Federal Reserve hike
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) trades just above 51,500 on Wednesday, down 576 points and 1.11%, its worst session of the month.

title: US Federal Reserve sends Gold to fresh one-month lows
summary: Spot Gold (XAU/USD) is closing Wednesday with losses, trading around $4,250 after hitting an intraday high of $4,366.

title: Saudi Oil Crisis Is About to Hit Europe
summary: Saudi Arabia’s oil supply crisis is rapidly becoming Europe’s problem. The September 10 attacks on Saudi Arabia’s East-West Pipeline struck the system at multiple locations and damaged at least one pumping station, forcing Riyadh to shut down the Kingdom’s critical alternative to the Strait of Hormuz. The 1,200-kilometer Petroline can carry around 7 million barrels per day from Saudi Arabia’s eastern producing regions to Yanbu on the Red Sea.
